variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Document parsing turns a PDF, image, form, or office file into structured records that software can search, validate, and act on. It may extract text, but it must also recover where each item appeared, how items relate, and which source region supports every result.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Match the parsing route to the document shape”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Digital PDF
pairs.detail: Start from native spans and coordinates, then reconstruct reading order and tables.
pairs.explanation: Start from native spans and coordinates, then reconstruct reading order and tables. Render pages for verification and unsupported regions.

pairs.label: Scanned form
pairs.detail: Deskew, denoise carefully, detect regions, run OCR or handwriting recognition, and preserve field geometry.
pairs.explanation: Deskew, denoise carefully, detect regions, run OCR or handwriting recognition, and preserve field geometry.

pairs.label: Complex report
pairs.detail: Combine native text, rendered-page layout detection, table structure, and section hierarchy across pages.
pairs.explanation: Combine native text, rendered-page layout detection, table structure, and section hierarchy across pages.

pairs.label: Mixed bundle
pairs.detail: Split attachments, classify page families, and send each family through a measured route instead of one expensive universal path.
pairs.explanation: Split attachments, classify page families, and send each family through a measured route instead of one expensive universal path.

variants.hint: Give each part the one job only it can do, then rule out the rest. Use the full lesson’s worked examples and interactive labs to explore the trade-offs behind these questions.

variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Document parsing turns a PDF, image, form, or office file into structured records that software can search, validate, and act on. It may extract text, but it must also recover where each item appeared, how items relate, and which source region supports every result.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Reconstruct tables as relationships”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Find the table region
pairs.detail: Separate the table from captions, footnotes, and neighboring columns.
pairs.explanation: Separate the table from captions, footnotes, and neighboring columns. Preserve its page coordinates.

pairs.label: Infer rows, columns, and spans
pairs.detail: Use borders, whitespace, alignment, token positions, and learned structure signals to propose a cell graph.
pairs.explanation: Use borders, whitespace, alignment, token positions, and learned structure signals to propose a cell graph.

pairs.label: Attach headers
pairs.detail: Resolve row and column headers, repeated headers, units, and multi-page continuation before producing records.
pairs.explanation: Resolve row and column headers, repeated headers, units, and multi-page continuation before producing records.

pairs.label: Reconcile the result
pairs.detail: Check totals, column types, expected keys, and source coverage.
pairs.explanation: Check totals, column types, expected keys, and source coverage. Hold ambiguous structures for review.

pairs.label: Dedoc
pairs.detail: Dedoc readers produce lines, tables, metadata, attachments, and warnings; structure extractors organize lines into a hierarchy.
pairs.explanation: Dedoc readers produce lines, tables, metadata, attachments, and warnings; structure extractors organize lines into a hierarchy. Verify current format and parameter support against its documentation.

pairs.label: Layout Parser
pairs.detail: Layout Parser provides abstractions for layout models, coordinates, visualization, and OCR integration.
pairs.explanation: Layout Parser provides abstractions for layout models, coordinates, visualization, and OCR integration. Choose and evaluate models against the actual document domain.

pairs.label: Tesseract
pairs.detail: Tesseract can emit text plus hOCR, TSV, ALTO, and PAGE outputs.
pairs.explanation: Tesseract can emit text plus hOCR, TSV, ALTO, and PAGE outputs. Keep word confidence and coordinates, but calibrate them on your own scans.

variants.prompt: What is the core invariant of a production document parsing system?
options: Every extracted claim remains traceable to its source region, parser identity, and validation result
Every page must run through OCR even when a reliable text layer exists
Every document type must use one universal model
Every output must be flattened into plain text
variants.explanation: Traceability lets software and reviewers verify where a value came from, reproduce the parse, and understand why it was released.
